hostPolicy.primary: GitHub-hosted standard macos-14 Apple Silicon runner; one complete randomized block per fresh virtual machine
hostPolicy.allocationUnit: the fresh virtual machine is the blocking unit; every tool in a block runs serially on that same virtual machine
hostPolicy.runnerImage: require and record ImageOS macos14 and ImageVersion 20260831.0302.1 for every block; any image update pauses collection and requires versioned change control
hostPolicy.concurrency: only one block job may run at a time; tools within a block run serially and may never overlap
hostPolicy.scope: claims apply to the exact declared GitHub-hosted macos-14 Apple M1 image
hostPolicy.crossEnvironment: physical-host, larger-runner, Intel, Linux, Windows, diagnostic, pilot, and confirmatory-v1 values are never pooled with this campaign

primaryFamilies.outcome: development server cold-start readiness in milliseconds
production build wall time, peak RSS, and CPU seconds from the same invocation

primaryFamilies.samplingUnit: one independently restarted watch session summarized by its measured-update median
one independently restarted browser and development-server session summarized by its measured-update median

secondaryOutcomes.M5-M9: descriptive output-contract measurements from accepted M2 complete blocks 1, 10, and 20 for each tool and workload; no extra builds and no null-hypothesis tests
secondaryOutcomes.M12: prespecified power-law scaling of M2 over the five synthetic sizes; descriptive slope and size-stratified bootstrap interval because different size blocks run on different virtual machines
secondaryOutcomes.allPairwiseComparisons: exploratory; clearly separated from reference-tool confirmatory contrasts

randomization.design: position-balanced randomized complete blocks within metric and workload

cacheAndWarmup.M1: remove declared tool caches and outputs before each process; do not drop operating-system page cache; no timed warmup
cacheAndWarmup.M2-M10-M11: remove declared tool caches and outputs before each process; do not drop operating-system page cache; no timed warmup
cacheAndWarmup.M3-M4: start a fresh session, perform one untimed stabilization edit, then five measured edits with a settled completion condition
cacheAndWarmup.betweenTools: restore byte-identical source and verify process-tree termination before the next scheduled cell

environmentGate.freshRunner: each attempt begins in a newly allocated GitHub-hosted job with no earlier benchmark cell in that virtual machine
environmentGate.memoryPressure: macOS memory_pressure -Q must report at least 50 percent system-wide memory free immediately before the block
environmentGate.backgroundState: record load average, process inventory, exact runner image, macOS, Chrome, Node, memory, and disk before and after every block; do not trim observations retrospectively using these diagnostics
preBlock: runner label, ImageOS, ImageVersion, macOS build, Chrome, architecture, core count, and memory match the frozen environment
runtime, dependency-lock, source, profile, schedule, and executor hashes match the freeze manifest
previous benchmark process tree is absent
environmentGate.rule: if a gate fails, postpone the entire block before observing an outcome

allowed: M4 full-page navigation, lost application state, browser error, or failed reload-detector control
forbidden: removal because a value changes a ranking or significance result
mixing a diagnostic, pilot, failed, or superseded campaign into confirmatory data
exclusions.replacement: retain the failed job artifact and reason, discard the entire incomplete randomized block from confirmatory inference, and rerun it under a new attempt identifier on a newly allocated virtual machine
exclusions.afterMaximum: pause the affected family and invoke change control; do not silently continue

analysis.contrast: each non-reference tool versus Webpack within the same metric and workload
analysis.test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test over complete blocks
analysis.effect: Hodges-Lehmann paired shift on log outcomes, exponentiated as a typical ratio
analysis.interval: 95% paired-block bootstrap confidence interval with 10000 deterministic resamples
analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across every confirmatory contrast in the metric family
analysis.descriptive: raw observations, failures, block order, median, IQR, and empirical distribution
analysis.M3-M4Reduction: one median per independent session before any inferential analysis
analysis.missingness: complete-block primary analysis; report all missing and replacement attempts
analysis.claimRule: a primary difference claim requires adjusted p < 0.05 and a confidence interval excluding ratio 1; practical magnitude is reported without a post-hoc threshold

changeControl.freeze: after capacity and deliberately failing collector controls pass, commit and hash this protocol, schedule, workflow, executors, source inventories, dependency locks, and profiles before the first timing observation
changeControl.measurementChange: any runtime, dependency, workload, configuration, collector, completion condition, exclusion, sample-count, or analysis change creates a new protocol version
changeControl.affectedData: observations collected under different protocol versions are never pooled for confirmatory inference
changeControl.supersession: confirmatory-v1 collected zero primary observations and is retained as superseded design history; it contributes no observations to v2
changeControl.artifactDurability: download and hash every completed or failed job artifact before GitHub retention expiry; publicationEligible cannot become true until the raw corpus is stored in a durable public repository with a persistent identifier
changeControl.unlock: publicationEligible may become true only after the planned matrix is complete, manifests validate, exclusions are audited, exact runner-image consistency is verified, durable archival is verified, and analysis reproduces from the archived corpus
